title: Platform, identities and durable records

title: Consent, authentication and privacy

title: Crew experience and daily check

title: Guided complaint intake
decisions: Map symptom modules to assessment families and sensitive-field rules

title: Capabilities and measurement workflow
decisions: Freeze adapter protocol, cancellation and operator acceptance

title: Personal and station cameras
decisions: Decide POS implementation, torso method, pairing and worker scheduling

title: Oximeter and clinical device adapters
decisions: Verify actual BLE protocol and device semantics

title: Wrist activity band and sleep pipeline
decisions: Select physical board, epoch units, storage and validated algorithm applicability

title: Reports and specialist findings
decisions: Decide supported file types, size limits, parsing sandbox and review UI

title: NASA registry and evidence database
decisions: Freeze inventory memberships, source hierarchy and review workflow

title: Urgent handling and pathway engine
decisions: Review exact clinical content and applicability separately from software logic

title: Retrieval and typed tool gateway
decisions: Benchmark lexical/dense/hybrid retrieval and tool schemas

title: Local reasoning and assessment
decisions: Test candidate checkpoint/template/thinking/JSON compatibility

title: Trends, environment and Chronos-2
decisions: Freeze comparison cohorts, resampling and temporal evaluation

title: Episodes, follow-up and clinical review
decisions: Define reviewer authority, resolution reasons and due-time policy

title: Ground console and delayed handoff
decisions: Define local delay simulator, receipt semantics and transport envelope

title: Model integration and tool-use optimization
decisions: Resolve original checkpoint/runtime compatibility, tool templates, context budgets and evaluation compute; no additional weight training

title: HealthBench and clinical evaluation
decisions: Pin official harness, grader, isolation and sample strategy

title: Research and content workbench
decisions: Define editor/reviewer workflow and literature-update policy

title: Accessibility, resilience and packaging
decisions: Decide packaging, local-network access, model scheduling and supported devices

title: Integration, evidence and demonstration
decisions: Freeze truthful demo claims and actual source modes

title: Participation streak, patches and crew goal
decisions: Fix the completion rule, mission-day boundary and clock-change policy, crew goal window and patch designs; keep the derivation free of values

title: Environment profile and habitat sensors
decisions: Freeze the environment and overlay vocabulary, the limit table built from ENVIRONMENTS.md, the sensor adapters and replay bindings, and each channel's expected reporting interval

title: Warnings engine
decisions: Freeze the four levels and their words, who may raise each, the clear conditions and reasons, the hold during sleep and walks, and the bounds on assistant insights

title: Routine scheduler and task guidance
decisions: Freeze the cadence vocabulary, due windows, trigger rules with reason, source and end, the number of misses before asking, and the task guidance format; frequencies come from ROUTINE.md or the flight surgeon

title: Someone needs help
decisions: Freeze the responder flows and their review state, the who, responding and breathing checks, the help-session access grant, the crew broadcast and the ground message states; keep every fixed step free of the model

title: Kit map: what this ship can test
decisions: Freeze the kit map schema, the precedence rule that computes each condition's state, the kit per environment and the planning list; split the 119 rows among writers and second checkers; keep every state computed, never stored or typed

title: Onboard plans: no dead ends
decisions: Freeze the plan schema and its stage order (check it another way, do now, watch, if it gets worse, the medical officer, return where the environment allows it, the log for the ground last and never blocking); the four modes (resolve here, talk a crewmate through it, stabilize and watch, prepare to return); the release validation that every kit map row has, in every environment, a plan with at least one step any crewmate can run with that kit; split the plan rows among writers and second checkers; keep medicine steps as "as in the onboard procedure" with no dose anywhere

title: The ground as a reader
decisions: Freeze the GroundLink fields (status up, delayed or down; one-way delay; next and last contact; gap kind; gap planned; source), the rule that nothing reads the link except the ground stage, the Habitat line and the ground-silence warning, the catch-up log with its leaves_at time, and the offline cache of plans and flows on every crew device

title: Teach and check
decisions: Freeze the skills catalog (teach steps with short and first-time text, landmarks, checks with sourced targets and tolerances with their basis, phrases); the GuidedCheck states and outcomes (agree, disagree, no reference); the rule that a guided check never confirms or excludes a condition and that disagreement writes no value; the experimental label on every camera check until the venue study

title: Who helps
decisions: Freeze SkillRecord and its computed freshness; the role rules (lead helper, second helper, kit fetcher, medical officer, communicator), eligibility (never the subject, nobody in a walk overlay for an on-site role) and the medical officer cascade; drills in the routine and practice patches that count completion only

title: Treat here: supplies and planning
decisions: Freeze the supplies list and stock per environment in the kit map, uses written by plan steps, cover computed from stock and the plans' declared rate, the cover warning, and the planning what-if that adds supplies and training beside instruments and writes nothing

title: Stay or return
decisions: Freeze the return stage (Moon base only), its criteria held as [to be set by flight rules], NASA's modeled chance from each form's Table 4 shown as context, the trip from NASA's figure, and the rule that the app lists and the commander and the medical officer decide
